official_procedure.finding: Registered-land adverse-possession applications require the prescribed application route and evidence of the facts relied upon.
Current guidance distinguishes adverse possession and possessory-title application materials.

primary_case_law.finding: A possession-based title claim requires analysis of the claimant's actual possession and the applicable limitation framework; mere passage of time is not presented as a standalone automatic title mechanism.

safe_public_proposition: A person claiming title through possession must establish the legally relevant possession and satisfy the applicable statutory framework and registration procedure; expiry of a limitation period does not by itself automatically produce a registered title.
critical_distinctions: First registration with possessory title is distinct from acquisition of registered land by possession.
Adverse possession of registered land is distinct from prescriptive easement.
The applicable law depends on the relevant historical period.
